summary: Repair canonical TW feature DatasetVersion admission by declaring feature_targets and storage_targets on tw-twse-tpex-official-market, generating checksummed returns feature rows in MarketDataStorageWriter, restoring strict feature_refs enforcement in source_dataset_authority, and verifying end-to-end admission through evaluation authority without relaxing schemas or assertions.

diagnosis.actual_gha_observation: In qualification run 37697565949 at a50197cd5c44f15911daa266f28a154bebf01f8e, L4 preview evaluation job failed with: 'RuntimeError: Teaching evaluation job failed: evaluation_admission_rejected: dataset DatasetVersion schema validation failed at feature_dataset_refs: [] should be non-empty'.
diagnosis.root_cause: The TW official market connector (tw-twse-tpex-official-market) did not declare feature_targets in its connector definition or adapter metadata, causing MarketDataStorageWriter to produce empty feature_refs. In commit a1e35f949, source_dataset_authority.py was relaxed to allow empty feature_refs when the connector did not declare feature targets, emitting feature_dataset_refs: []. Downstream, load_evaluation_authority strictly validated against canonical dataset_version.schema.json which enforces minItems: 1 on feature_dataset_refs, failing evaluation admission.
diagnosis.producer_consumer_mismatch: Existing MarketDataStorageWriter already supported writing feature target rows to features/{feature_dataset}/date={date}/{run_id}.jsonl, but tw-twse-tpex-official-market metadata was missing feature_targets ('returns') matching active universe policy ('features/returns'). Reconciling the producer metadata with the materializer restored real checksummed feature artifacts without fabricated refs or aliases.

fix.producer: In services/source_ingestion/connector_definitions.py, declared feature_targets ('returns') and storage_targets ('normalized/tw_price_daily', 'features/returns') on tw-twse-tpex-official-market. In services/source_ingestion/market_data_storage.py, enhanced _feature_targets to inspect storage_targets and connector definition metadata so official market pulls produce real returns feature files.
fix.materializer: In services/training-session/source_dataset_authority.py, removed the bypass helper and restored unconditional requirement of non-empty feature_refs with minimum 1 summary count, binding real checksummed feature storage paths into feature_dataset_refs.
fix.tests_and_gates: Updated test_source_dataset_authority.py to verify TW materialization produces non-empty feature_dataset_refs and passes strict load_evaluation_authority admission; added regression tests verifying that missing feature_refs and altered feature row artifacts are strictly rejected.
